title: Shared office day passes
bodyMd:
Every available pass permits one desk-day. The table covers the same month at all sites. Sales never exceed availability.

| Category | Available desk-days | Sold desk-days |
|---|---:|---:|
| Arcade | 120 | 90 |
| Station | 180 | 126 |
| Canal | 300 | 270 |
